questions.question: What did Job point out that contradicted his friends?
options: The righteous never once suffer at all
The wicked always die very young
The wicked often grow old and prosper
questions.answer: The wicked often grow old and prosper

questions.question: How did the wicked treat God, according to Job?
options: They feared him and kept his law
They worshiped him with great devotion
They told God to depart, not wanting his ways
They served him faithfully all their days
questions.answer: They told God to depart, not wanting his ways

questions.question: Job said the wicked spend their days in prosperity and go down to the grave in peace.
Job said his friends' answers were left as _____.
Job asked how often the lamp of the wicked is actually put _____.
